authorization.verbatim: roll back would have been nice but we have evidence that our 160 work is solid so let's proceed
authorization.interpretation: Proceed with beta.160 production adoption while explicitly accepting the absence of a proven beta.159 rollback environment.

reviews: frontend review approved as not applicable
independent persistence-r5 live evidence review approved

waiver.residualRisk: No preserved beta.159 deployment and volume was available to prove rollback isolation. There is no validated binary downgrade path if beta.160 production adoption fails.

mandatoryGuardrails: use a newly provisioned, preflight-empty beta.160 volume only
record and verify exact release images, rendered Compose, configuration, and inputs
verify recoverable backups of authoritative reseed inputs, rendered configuration, deployment metadata, and nondisposable product data before production writes
retain r5, conformance, review, audit, and release-decision evidence
during cutover and for at least 60 minutes after traffic begins, poll health, GRAPH_STATUS revisions, critical CS API probes, observations, and artifact reads every 30-60 seconds
abort on retained state, pin drift, readiness regression, parity failure, panic, OOM, storage-limit breach, or unreconciled commit uncertainty
on abort stop traffic and writes, preserve evidence and beta.160 state, then use forward repair or a clean beta.160 rebuild from verified backups
